description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the AuthProviderDao component in the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin. It contains tests for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying authentication providers and their details.

classes.name: AuthProviderDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the AuthProviderDao methods related to OpenID Providers in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test by loading fixture data into the database.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an auth provider by its ID.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderDetailsByProviderId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of auth provider details by provider ID.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviders
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of auth providers with pagination parameters.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderCount
methods.description: Tests counting the total number of auth providers based on filters.

methods.name: testDeleteProviders
methods.description: Tests deletion (or deactivation) of providers by IDs.

methods.name: testSaveProvider
methods.description: Tests saving a new OpenID provider.

methods.name: testSaveAuthProviderExtraDetails
methods.description: Tests saving extra details for an auth provider.

methods.name: testGetAuthProvidersForLoginPage
methods.description: Tests retrieving providers suitable for login page display.
